steps.name: store-owner-inventory-domain-commands
steps.summary: Added audited store-owner inventory business commands for stock intake, total-stock correction, sale pause/resume, duplicate detection, and saleStatus domain behavior.

steps.name: store-owner-inventory-query-api
steps.summary: Added listStoreOwnerInventory route, StoreOwnerInventoryApi query facade, query repository contract, PostgreSQL query adapter, and docs for STORE_OWNER own-store vs ADMIN inventory visibility.

steps.name: store-owner-stock-mutation-api
steps.summary: Added stock intake, correction, pause, and resume HTTP routes with Idempotency-Key/CSRF handling, command dispatch, route manifest entries, and Postman expected fixtures.

steps.name: inventory-authz-audit-idempotency
steps.summary: Enforced STORE_OWNER ownership and ADMIN override checks, persisted inventory audit records with before/after stock and actor metadata, and kept duplicate idempotency retries from writing extra audit or inventory rows.

steps.name: store-owner-inventory-public-verification
steps.summary: Locked public route/docs/Postman contracts for the 21-route manifest and documented that UI implementation and manual order approval remain out of this phase.
